WITH grouped AS (
  SELECT a.link_to_member, m.position, COUNT(*) AS attendance_count
  FROM attendance AS a
  JOIN member AS m
    ON CAST(m.member_id AS TEXT) = CAST(a.link_to_member AS TEXT)
  GROUP BY a.link_to_member, m.position
),
total AS (
  SELECT SUM(attendance_count) AS total_count
  FROM grouped
)
SELECT g.link_to_member, g.position, g.attendance_count,
       1.0 * g.attendance_count / total.total_count
FROM grouped AS g
CROSS JOIN total
ORDER BY 4 DESC
LIMIT 10
